```{r}
set.seed(501322)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(MASS)
```

```{r}
data <- read_csv("tourism_finaldf.csv")

data$reporter_area_label <- as.factor(data$reporter_area_label)
```

```{r}
library(corrplot)
data_nocountry <- data %>% dplyr::select(-reporter_area_label)
cor_data <- cor(data_nocountry, use="pairwise.complete.obs")
corrplot(cor_data)
heatmap(cor_data, symm = TRUE)
```


```{r}
lin_0 <- lmer(value ~ 1 + (1 | reporter_area_label), data)
summary(lin_0)
plot(lin_0)
```

```{r}
lin_year <- lmer(value ~ year + (1 | reporter_area_label), data)
summary(lin_year)
plot(lin_year)
```

```{r}
lin_all <- lmer(value ~ year + population_l + exchangerate_l + railpassengers_l + gdptotal_l + gdpgrowthrate_l + gdppercapita + 
                  Airports + NumNatParks + TotalParkAreaKM + ParkAreaPercent + OldestPark + total_sites_cultural + total_sites_mixed + total_sites_natural + 
                  (1 | reporter_area_label), data)
summary(lin_all)
plot(lin_all)
```

```{r}
ranef_lin_all <- ranef(lin_all)
ranef_df <- as.data.frame(ranef_lin_all)
ranef_selection <- ranef_df %>%
  filter(abs(condval) > 10000)
ggplot(ranef_selection, aes(x = condval, y = reorder(grp, condval))) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = condval - condsd, xmax = condval + condsd), 
                 height = 0, color = "darkgray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Random Effects (Absolute Estimate > 10,000)",
       x = "Random Effect Estimate",
       y = "Country")
```

```{r}
boxcox(value ~ year, data = data, lambda = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.05))
```

```{r}
lin_log_all <- lmer(log(value) ~ year + population_l + exchangerate_l + railpassengers_l + gdptotal_l + gdpgrowthrate_l + gdppercapita + 
                  Airports + NumNatParks + TotalParkAreaKM + ParkAreaPercent + OldestPark + total_sites_cultural + total_sites_mixed + total_sites_natural + 
                  (1 | reporter_area_label), data)
summary(lin_log_all)
plot(lin_log_all)
```

```{r}
data_standardized <- data %>%
  mutate(year_s = scale(year)) %>%
  mutate(population_l = scale(population_l)) %>%
  mutate(exchangerate_l = scale(exchangerate_l)) %>%
  mutate(railpassengers_l = scale(railpassengers_l)) %>%
  mutate(gdptotal_l  = scale(gdptotal_l )) %>%
  mutate(gdpgrowthrate_l = scale(gdpgrowthrate_l)) %>%
  mutate(gdppercapita  = scale(gdppercapita )) %>%
  mutate(Airports = scale(Airports)) %>%
  mutate(NumNatParks = scale(NumNatParks)) %>%
  mutate(TotalParkAreaKM = scale(TotalParkAreaKM)) %>%
  mutate(ParkAreaPercent = scale(ParkAreaPercent)) %>%
  mutate(OldestPark = scale(OldestPark)) %>%
  mutate(total_sites_cultural = scale(total_sites_cultural)) %>%
  mutate(total_sites_mixed = scale(total_sites_mixed)) %>%
  mutate(total_sites_natural = scale(total_sites_natural))
```

```{r}
lin_log_all_s <- lmer(log(value) ~ year_s + population_l + exchangerate_l + railpassengers_l + gdptotal_l + gdpgrowthrate_l + gdppercapita + 
                  Airports + NumNatParks + TotalParkAreaKM + ParkAreaPercent + OldestPark + total_sites_cultural + total_sites_mixed + total_sites_natural + 
                  (1 | reporter_area_label), data_standardized)
summary(lin_log_all_s)
plot(lin_log_all_s)
```


```{r}
lin_glmer <- glmer(value ~ year_s + population_l + exchangerate_l + railpassengers_l + gdpgrowthrate_l + gdppercapita + 
                  Airports + NumNatParks + TotalParkAreaKM + OldestPark + total_sites_cultural + total_sites_mixed + total_sites_natural + 
                  (1 | reporter_area_label), family = poisson(link = "log"), data = data_standardized, nAGQ = 1)

summary(lin_glmer)
plot(lin_glmer)
qqnorm(residuals(lin_glmer))
```

```{r}
lin_glmer_nb <- glmer.nb(value ~ year_s + population_l + exchangerate_l + railpassengers_l + gdpgrowthrate_l + gdppercapita + 
                  Airports + NumNatParks + TotalParkAreaKM + OldestPark + total_sites_cultural + total_sites_mixed + total_sites_natural + 
                  (1 | reporter_area_label), data = data_standardized)

summary(lin_glmer_nb)
plot(lin_glmer_nb)
qqnorm(residuals(lin_glmer_nb))
```

```{r}
data_mcmcglmm <- data_standardized |> dplyr::select(-railpassengers_l) %>% drop_na()

```


```{r}
library(MCMCglmm)
prior_poisson <- list(
  R = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002),
  G = list(G1 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002))
)
lin_mcmc <- MCMCglmm(round(value, 0) ~ year_s + population_l + exchangerate_l + gdpgrowthrate_l + gdppercapita + 
                  Airports + NumNatParks + TotalParkAreaKM + OldestPark + total_sites_cultural + total_sites_mixed + total_sites_natural,
                  random = ~reporter_area_label,
                  family = "poisson",
                  data = data_mcmcglmm, 
                  prior = prior_poisson,
                  nitt = 50000, 
                  burnin = 10000, 
                  thin = 10
                  )
```

```{r}
summary(lin_mcmc)
```

```{r}
par(mar=c(2,2,2,2))
plot(lin_mcmc)
```

```{r}
mcmc_output <- predict(lin_mcmc)
poisson_output <- predict(lin_glmer)
nb_output <- predict(lin_glmer_nb)
lin_output <- predict(lin_all)

poisson_output
nb_output
```

```{r}
data_actualvspredicted <- data_mcmcglmm |> dplyr::select(c(...1, reporter_area_label, year, value))
data_actualvspredicted$mcmc_prediction <- mcmc_output

predicted_rows <- names(poisson_output)
df_others <- data_standardized[predicted_rows,] %>%
  dplyr::select(...1) %>%
  mutate(
    poisson_prediction = exp(poisson_output),
    nb_prediction = exp(nb_output),
    lin_prediction = lin_output
  )

data_actualvspredicted <- data_actualvspredicted %>%
  left_join(df_others, by = "...1")
```


```{r}
data_actualvspredicted_stats <- data_actualvspredicted %>%
  group_by(reporter_area_label) %>%
  summarise(
    mean(value),
    mean(mcmc_prediction),
    mean(poisson_prediction, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(nb_prediction, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(lin_prediction, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

data_long_avp_s <- data_actualvspredicted_stats %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("mean(mcmc_prediction)", "mean(poisson_prediction, na.rm = TRUE)", "mean(nb_prediction, na.rm = TRUE)", "mean(lin_prediction, na.rm = TRUE)"), 
    names_to = "model_type", 
    values_to = "predicted_mean"
  ) %>%
  mutate(model_type = case_match(
    model_type,
    "mean(mcmc_prediction)" ~ "MCMCglmm",
    "mean(poisson_prediction, na.rm = TRUE)" ~ "Poisson",
    "mean(nb_prediction, na.rm = TRUE)" ~ "Negative Binomial",
    "mean(lin_prediction, na.rm = TRUE)" ~ "Linear"
  ))
```

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

ggplot(data_long_avp_s, aes(x = predicted_mean, y = `mean(value)`, label = reporter_area_label, color = model_type, shape = model_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  xlim(0,2000000) +
  ylim(0,2000000) +
  labs(title = "MCMCglmm Output",
       x = "Predicted Average Annual Visitors (thousands)",
       y = "Actual Average Annual Visitors (thousands)")

ggplot(data_long_avp_s, aes(x = predicted_mean, y = `mean(value)`, label = reporter_area_label, color = model_type, shape = model_type)) +
```
